title: EMA6 Crossings of Globex VWAP
summary: Corrected 3-minute close EMA6 study: full-Globex mean crossings ES 10.98, NQ 10.72, GC 9.39. Realized quiet-range/ATR days had more crossings than active days; prior ATR regimes separated weakly and inconsistently.
data_summary: Pinned minute-source 3m OHLCV and HLC3/volume Globex VWAP with unchanged retrospective eligibility and daily ATR. Common 2021-06-28–2026-09-18: ES 1,037, NQ 1,177, GC 418 sessions; 357 shared dates. Earlier 5m/2m run preserved.
evidence_status: Corrected protocol 1.1.0 sealed: 25 synthetic tests, full source reconciliation of 1,397,940 bars and 32,006 crossings, saved tables/bootstrap, nine EMA source sessions, and prior-run coverage/range/ATR invariants passed. 107-artifact integrity is distinct from science; sample selection and sparse GC coverage remain.
